subject: Project Management
notes: Project management core. Numerical answers are stated in correctAnswer with working in explanation.

questions.text: A temporary endeavour undertaken to create a unique product or service is a
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: A project is temporary and produces a unique deliverable.

questions.text: The first phase of the project life cycle is
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Initiation defines the project and its objectives first.

questions.text: The person responsible for delivering the project objectives is the project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: The project manager leads planning and execution to meet objectives.

questions.text: A project is a continuous ongoing operation like production
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: A project is temporary and unique unlike ongoing operations.

questions.text: List the phases of the project life cycle
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Initiation planning execution monitoring and control and closure.
questions.explanation: These five phases take a project from idea to completion.

questions.text: Explain the characteristics of a project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: A project has defined objectives a fixed duration unique output limited resources and cross functional teamwork and progresses through a life cycle.
questions.explanation: Cover the temporary unique and resource bound nature of projects.

questions.text: The statement of what the project will deliver is the project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Scope defines the deliverables and boundaries of the project.

questions.text: Breaking a project into smaller manageable parts is the work breakdown
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: The work breakdown structure decomposes work into tasks.

questions.text: Project planning is the first and most important function of project management
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Planning sets objectives scope schedule and resources for the project.

questions.text: List the steps in project planning
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Defining objectives identifying activities sequencing estimating resources and scheduling.
questions.explanation: These steps build the project plan.

questions.text: Explain the importance of project planning
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Planning clarifies objectives allocates resources sets the schedule and provides the baseline for control reducing uncertainty and risk.
questions.explanation: Cover clarity resource allocation and control baseline.

questions.text: The network technique used to schedule project activities is
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: CPM and PERT are network techniques for scheduling projects.

questions.text: The longest path of activities through a project network is the
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: The critical path determines the shortest project completion time.

questions.text: PERT is used when activity durations are certain while CPM is used when they are uncertain
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: PERT handles uncertain durations while CPM uses deterministic durations.

questions.text: List the differences between CPM and PERT
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: CPM is activity oriented with deterministic times while PERT is event oriented with probabilistic time estimates.
questions.explanation: The difference lies in orientation and certainty of durations.

questions.text: Explain the steps in drawing a project network
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: A network is built by listing activities determining their sequence and dependencies drawing nodes and arrows and then computing earliest and latest times.
questions.explanation: Cover activity listing sequencing and time computation.

questions.text: The estimation and control of project costs is project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Project costing estimates and controls the money spent on a project.

questions.text: The document that details the financial plan of a project is the project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: The project budget allocates funds across activities and time.

questions.text: Cost overrun occurs when actual cost exceeds the budget
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Cost overrun is spending more than the planned budget.

questions.text: List the sources of project finance
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Equity debt term loans grants and internal accruals.
questions.explanation: These sources provide capital for project investment.

questions.text: Explain the techniques of project cost estimation
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Cost estimation uses analogous parametric and bottom up methods ranging from quick historical estimates to detailed activity by activity costing.
questions.explanation: Describe each technique and when it is used.

questions.text: The process of tracking project progress against the plan is
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Monitoring tracks progress against the project plan.

questions.text: The chance of an event that could harm the project is a project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Project risk is uncertainty that may affect objectives.

questions.text: Risk management aims to eliminate all risks from a project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Risk cannot be eliminated only identified assessed and managed.

questions.text: List the steps in project control
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Setting standards measuring performance comparing with standards and taking corrective action.
questions.explanation: This control cycle keeps the project on track.

questions.text: Explain the process of project risk management
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Risk management identifies risks assesses their likelihood and impact develops responses and monitors them throughout the project.
questions.explanation: Trace risk identification assessment response and monitoring.

questions.text: The structure that brings people from different functions to work on a project is a
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: A matrix organisation combines functional and project authority.

questions.text: The formal completion and handover of the project is project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Project closure completes the work and hands over the deliverable.

questions.text: A project can be terminated early if its objectives are no longer viable
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Projects may end early due to failure or changed objectives.

questions.text: List the types of project organisation
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: These structures differ in where project authority resides.

questions.text: Explain the responsibilities of a project manager
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: The project manager plans organises leads and controls the project managing scope time cost quality risk and the team to meet objectives.
questions.explanation: Cover planning leadership and control responsibilities.

questions.text: Assertion: The critical path has zero float. Reason: Any delay on the critical path delays the whole project
questions.subject: Project Management
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: Critical activities have no slack so their delay extends the project.

questions.text: Match the concept to its meaning
questions.subject: Project Management
options: Float - spare time in an activity
questions.explanation: Float is spare time while the critical path is the longest path.

questions.text: The slack time available in a non critical activity is called float
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Float is the spare time an activity can be delayed without delaying the project.

questions.text: Explain the meaning and importance of feasibility analysis of a project
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Feasibility analysis assesses technical economic financial and social viability before commitment to avoid investing in unworkable projects.
questions.explanation: Cover the dimensions of feasibility and its importance.

questions.text: Read the case: A construction project is falling behind schedule because two activities on the critical path are delayed. Explain the consequence and a corrective measure
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Delays on the critical path delay the whole project. The manager should crash the critical activities by adding resources to shorten their duration.
questions.explanation: Apply critical path logic and propose crashing.

questions.text: Read the case: A software project has a fixed deadline and a team with limited skills in a new technology. Identify the risk and suggest a mitigation
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: The risk is skill shortage causing schedule slippage. The manager should provide training or hire specialists early to mitigate it.
questions.explanation: Identify the skill risk and propose early mitigation.

questions.text: A project has three activities of duration 4 6 and 8 days that must run in sequence. The total project duration is
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Sequential activities sum to 4 plus 6 plus 8 which equals 18 days.

questions.text: Explain the causes of project failure
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Projects fail due to poor planning unclear objectives inadequate resources poor communication and weak risk management.
questions.explanation: Cover the planning and management causes of failure.

questions.text: The process of closing out all project activities is project termination
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Termination completes and closes the project formally.

questions.text: Explain the steps in project termination
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Termination involves completing remaining work handing over deliverables releasing resources documenting lessons and closing accounts.
questions.explanation: Cover handover resource release and documentation.

questions.text: List the benefits of using CPM and PERT
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Better planning identifying the critical path resource optimisation and progress control.
questions.explanation: These benefits improve scheduling and control.

questions.text: Explain the concept and types of project appraisal
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Project appraisal evaluates technical economic financial and managerial feasibility using methods like net present value and internal rate of return.
questions.explanation: Cover the appraisal dimensions and financial techniques.

questions.text: The expected time in PERT is calculated from optimistic pessimistic and most likely times
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: PERT computes expected time as a weighted average of the three estimates.

questions.text: Explain the importance of project organisation structure
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: The organisation structure defines authority and coordination affecting communication and control so the right structure improves project delivery.
questions.explanation: Link structure to authority communication and control.

questions.text: The estimate of costs based on a similar past project is
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Analogous estimating uses historical project data for a quick estimate.

questions.text: Explain the tools used for project monitoring
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Monitoring uses Gantt charts network diagrams milestone reports and earned value analysis to track progress and detect deviations.
questions.explanation: Describe each tool and its use in tracking.

questions.text: A milestone is a significant point or event in a project schedule
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.explanation: Milestones mark important events with zero duration in a schedule.

questions.text: Explain the importance of project scheduling
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Scheduling sequences activities sets timelines allocates resources and provides the basis for monitoring and controlling project progress.
questions.explanation: Cover sequencing timelines and control baseline.

questions.text: Explain the concept and importance of project team building
questions.subject: Project Management
questions.correctAnswer: Team building develops cooperation trust and shared goals among project members improving communication and performance.
questions.explanation: Cover cooperation communication and performance benefits.
